data.review_body:
AliExpress,

I am disappointed by the lack of transparency and accountability regarding the Football Mania credit exchange program. Many users invested significant time and effort participating in the event, earning credits with the expectation that they could be redeemed as advertised.

However, the redemption process has been unclear, inconsistent, and extremely frustrating. Credits often become unavailable instantly, opportunities to redeem appear limited without explanation, and users are left without meaningful communication about how the system operates.

Participants deserve clear information about redemption availability, allocation rules, and any limitations affecting exchanges. A promotional event should provide a fair and realistic opportunity for users to obtain the rewards they have worked toward.

I respectfully request that AliExpress provide greater transparency regarding the Football Mania credit exchange system and offer a fair solution for users who were unable to redeem their earned credits despite actively participating in the promotion.

Thank you.

data.review_body:
I am extremely disappointed with AliExpress and the way my return of two dresses was handled. The dresses did not fit me, and I followed the correct return process. The seller confirmed that the return should be free, but instead of a smooth solution, I had to deal with a complicated and frustrating process.
I felt that AliExpress did not properly protect the buyer. Even though I provided all the necessary information and tried to resolve everything fairly, the return process was stressful and time-consuming.
Be careful when ordering clothes on AliExpress. If the item does not fit, returning it may not be as easy as expected. I expected better customer service and stronger support for buyers.
This experience has seriously affected my trust in AliExpress. I hope the return system will be improved so other customers do not have to go through the same problems.
